name: Keep
description: Keep is an open-source tracker for castles and fortifications. It synchronises keeps from the Keep Data project and lets you log your visits, organise keeps into collections and see them on a map.

notes.text: There is no default account: register one at /register, then set REGISTRATION_DISABLED=true in /opt/keep_data/.env and run `php artisan optimize` in /opt/keep to close sign-up.
Keep data is synchronised from keep-data.voke.dev during install and daily at 03:00. Run `php artisan app:sync` in /opt/keep to sync manually.

Passkeys need a secure context, so serve Keep over HTTPS (for example behind a reverse proxy). Set APP_URL to the HTTPS URL and TRUSTED_PROXIES to the proxy's IP in /opt/keep_data/.env, then run `php artisan optimize` in /opt/keep.
